main_characters: A `solid lead`, indeed... It turned out that Steph was involved in the plot to incriminate the guys from Centerscore...

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you guess who started the fire?
Do you forge alliances with enemies?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, so what's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I guess the first thing we need to do is establish what activities need the most attention. Any ideas?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: First, Mallika spoke up...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hector, we wanted to set up a Mobile Command Station to coordinate all of our team's events.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: We were going to retrofit my `Fjord Tiara`, but it's a compact car. We need more space to fit all the equipment.
nodes.text_bbcode: We were going to retrofit my [color=#3b78e2][i]Fjord Tiara[/i][/color], but it's a compact car. We need more space to fit all the equipment.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No problemo, Mallika. I think the Party Van could take a break from partying long enough to kick Wilson High's keister.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Then Dinah followed...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Megan and I were putting together a remote-controlled boat to carry our team's `torch` across Lake Centerscore.
nodes.text_bbcode: Megan and I were putting together a remote-controlled boat to carry our team's [color=#3b78e2][i]torch[/i][/color] across Lake Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, if you'd like to help...?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Whatever, Goth Girl. We don't need some cyber-nerd telling us what to do.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, what if we just...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: `We don't!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We don't![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How about I just take a look at what you've done, and then you two can decide if I'll be able to contribute anything?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... I think that was a 'yes'... Or possibly Megan's getting hungry.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Then Linda brought up the final task.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, before you were sent to Boot Camp, we talked about doing the three-legged race together.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Then while you were gone, Kenji volunteered to take your place...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I'll bet he did.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But unfortunately, with everything that's gone on, we never got to practice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that's an easy fix. I mean... If you want, you and I can run the race together... Just like we were supposed to.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... I think we can make that work.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Howard raised his voice to address the assembled students.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great. So we all know what we're going to do. Everyone, gather round.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: On the count of three, we cheer... One... Two...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The Centerscore kids `cheered` loudly, enthusiasm growing for the day when they would prove their mettle at the Crosstown Races.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Centerscore kids [color=#e23b3b][i]cheered[/i][/color] loudly, enthusiasm growing for the day when they would prove their mettle at the Crosstown Races.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But as Howard, Brendan, and Hector set out to begin their preparations, they couldn't help but remember what Alexei had told them.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The person who burned down the Wilson High library was still out there... Somewhere...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And that night, after their work was done, Howard, Brendan, Hector, and Alexei intended to sniff the culprit out.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Running `scared?` Seriously?! Did you miss the Prank War, or the bee bombs, or the millipede sandwiches they keep serving us for lunch?
nodes.text_bbcode: Running [color=#e23b3b][i]scared?[/i][/color] Seriously?! Did you miss the Prank War, or the bee bombs, or the millipede sandwiches they keep serving us for lunch?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: I even hear Spartan Academy is bragging that they may take the trophy this year. Did you hear that? Spartan!!!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Spartan? Doubtful. They may win everything else, but they'll always lose the Crosstown Races because they can't work together as a team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys, I'm totally serious. If somebody out there wasn't terrified that we'd win, why would they go to such incredible lengths to make sure that Brendan, Hector, and I couldn't compete?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Well, that is... Huh. You do make a good point.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They didn't think they could beat Centerscore in a fair race. Well, guess what... Brendan, Hector, and I are back!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that means Centerscore has a fighting chance... More than a fighting chance!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm telling you guys... `We can win the Crosstown Races!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm telling you guys... [color=#e23b3b][i]We can win the Crosstown Races!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The students clapped their hands in approval!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Uh... What?! Maybe all that prison chow has gone to your brain, but there's no way we're going to beat Wilson this year.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: In fact, word on the street is we might even lose to Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Spartan? Doubtful. They may win everything else, but they'll always lose the Crosstown Races because they can't work together as a team.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Forget the competition. The truth is... We're way behind on prep. There's no way we can get everything together in time for the race.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know it seems like a long shot, guys... But we're all here! We're a team again! If we work hard, I `know` we can do this!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know it seems like a long shot, guys... But we're all here! We're a team again! If we work hard, I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] we can do this!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Yeah well, I guess it doesn't hurt to hear you out.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Guys... Just, guys... Listen to me!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Come on! This is pointless, Linda... Without the rest of our team, we don't have a chance of winning the Crosstown Races.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I hate to admit it, but the dweeb is right.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Hey! Who are you calling a dweeb, preppy?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ew! I'm calling you a dweeb, dweeb!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Cut it out, all of you! If you guys can't stop arguing with each other, we might as well pack it up and go home now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How about that? I've known you guys for a long time...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I never figured you for quitters!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! Brendan! Hector! You guys are back!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We sure are! And it's all thanks to the proof you and Amanda found!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As Howard and Linda kissed, Hector raced to Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector, we're so glad you were...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, it's really great to see you again.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And Brendan raced to Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: BlueDaNoob, ElbowBagHands, are they leveled up? Did everyone upgrade to the new 'Winterbride' expansion pack? How are we doing in the arena rankings? Is there a chance we...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, your clan is fine!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Good?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sorry, Brendan. I'm just... Really happy to see you again. The real you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm happy to see you, too.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But as heartwarming as this reunion was, there was another pressing item on the agenda... Namely, `The Crosstown Races.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But as heartwarming as this reunion was, there was another pressing item on the agenda... Namely, [color=#e23b3b][i]The Crosstown Races.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But what are the Crosstown Races, you might be asking yourself?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, the answer is simple. Each year, Centerscore High, Wilson High, and Spartan Academy compete in a series of events that stretch from one side of Centerscore to the other...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: These extremely varied events are designed to test physical strength, intelligence, and raw cunning.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: By winning events, a school  accumulates points, and at the end of the race, the school with the most points wins!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Historically, Centerscore had always done well at the Races, but this year, Howard gazed out across a sea of dispirited faces.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys, listen to me. I know you're all disheartened. I know you all think we can't win the Crosstown Races this year...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Win? We'll be lucky if all we do is lose.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Remember what happened when that kid from `Spartan Academy` tossed chunks during the hotdog eating event last year? They still call him 'The Spewmaster General'.
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember what happened when that kid from [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan Academy[/i][/color] tossed chunks during the hotdog eating event last year? They still call him 'The Spewmaster General'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, I know... But there's something you've all forgotten.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no... Did I leave my goldfish plugged in again?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda, shh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, that's right... I don't have a goldfish anymore.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What you've all forgotten is this: Those other teams are...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So the boys made their way to Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As they arrived, Linda was addressing the assembled team.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: The night of the fire, I saw three guys dressed like they were from Centerscore running away from the library.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I assumed it was you three, only... You've since proven your innocence.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But that's not all, is it? There's something else you haven't told us.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: When I went back to check on the fireworks my crew stole from Hector's van, I discovered they'd been taken.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: But the only people who knew where those fireworks were hidden go to Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Which means... You've got a `traitor` on your own team!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means... You've got a [color=#e23b3b][i]traitor[/i][/color] on your own team!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That's right! We've both been duped, and whoever framed you for arson also torched a building at `my` school!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right! We've both been duped, and whoever framed you for arson also torched a building at [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] school!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: AT `MY SCHOOL!!! SO NOT COOL!!!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but we're going to have to work together if we want to figure out who did this to us.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, the guys weren't exactly thrilled to find themselves in an alliance with their former rival... But what other choice did they have?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: There was a `mystery` to be solved!
nodes.text_bbcode: There was a [color=#e23b3b][i]mystery[/i][/color] to be solved!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, Alexei, say we believe you. What happens next?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Well... I have a plan.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The boys listened to Alexei's plan, and agreed to reconvene at Wilson High later that night for `Operation: Eavesdrop.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The boys listened to Alexei's plan, and agreed to reconvene at Wilson High later that night for [color=#e23b3b][i]Operation: Eavesdrop.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Then, after Alexei drove off...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh... All this time we assumed Alexei was behind the fire. I guess we never really thought it through.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Alexei may not have started that fire, but he's still a total creep.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's enough, guys. We still need to go say hello to everyone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And if I remember the practice schedule correctly, the whole team should be meeting at school for a Crosstown Races strategy session.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I appreciate your good faith. Right now... I don't know who to trust.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... You do know we don't trust you, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, no...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not even a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Maybe not, but at least I know you're `innocent.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe not, but at least I know you're [color=#e23b3b][i]innocent.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You... You do? Then why'd you get us arrested?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: With that, Howard leapt at Alexei!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ow... Hey, get off me! Get off!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Fight back, you coward!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: No! For once, I'm not here to fight you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You... you're not?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: No! I'm not! I'm just here to talk.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe we should hear him out, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... Okay, but you better make it good.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, girls... What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Look at how those spikes gleam off the shiny, black lacquer finish! Nobody'll be able to come close to us!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And now that the boat is more buoyant, you can totally see how powerful that lawnmower engine is!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Great job! I think we have a real shot at winning this event!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh... That doesn't look like these blueprints at all. And what's that popping sound I keep hearing?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... I think maybe I put the spikes too close to the tires and popped one of them.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just one?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Gulp... Or all of them!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Way to go, Goth Face! You got the ignition wet! Now we'll have to wait for the engine to dry before we can take her out again!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... Like this was all `my` idea!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Like this was all [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] idea!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no... This is a total disaster! Maybe I should've stayed out of this!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, stability is the primary factor. This boat has to be able to carry a lit torch all the way across Lake Centerscore without capsizing.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If the torch gets dunked, the race will be over.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We'll also need some way to repel the other boats in case they try to attack us.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hmm... Well, car tires are pretty buoyant, right? I have some spares we could use to make pontoons.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And I have a bunch of chrome spikes left over from my leatherworking class. We could use them to poke anything that gets near us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sounds great, guys! Let's get to work!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Slow?! I'll show you slow!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait! Megan, just hear Brendan out!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What I was trying to say is... Lawnmower engines make a great propulsion system...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, duh!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But you haven't accounted for the extra weight.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: As it is, this boat will ride so low that you'll be `pushing` through the water instead of skimming on top of it.
nodes.text_bbcode: As it is, this boat will ride so low that you'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]pushing[/i][/color] through the water instead of skimming on top of it.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Huh... I guess we didn't think of that. We got so caught up in making the boat powerful, we forgot that it had to be light, too.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Maybe we can use someone like you, after all.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And so, the work began in earnest...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So, Brendan, what else do you think our boat needs?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Because 'sinister' was... You know... Kind of the vibe we were going for!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I really like how it lists to one side... Because I'm always saying boats should try to take on more water.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It really gives you that 'sinking deathtrap aura'.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, you don't actually like our boat, do you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, of course I do! It's... Really... Really... Super?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You know what I consider great? People who aren't afraid to speak their minds!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: If you have a problem with this boat, should just say so!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm sure Brendan meant to, Megan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I did?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sure, you did, Brendan. You just didn't want to hurt my feelings, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh yeah, right. That's what it was.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well... Just try not to sugarcoat it next time. We want our boat to look cool for sure, but winning has to be our top priority.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And so, Brendan told Megan and Dinah the truth.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That same afternoon, Brendan ventured out to Lake Centerscore to meet with Dinah and Megan...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Dinah, I wanted to thank you again for looking after my clan while I was gone. I hope it wasn't too much trouble.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yes, I mean... No. I mean... It was a lot of work, but I was happy to help you out.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Cool. Well, I'm really excited to see the radio-controlled boat you've constructed for the Crosstown Races!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, okay... Here it is.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Where?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Right here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan

nodes.text: Yeah! That's our boat. Its name is `Rudder Destruction.` Cool, huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... By running the signal in parallel, I boosted our transmission radius to cover the whole town!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We could do events on the moon and still get crystal clear reception!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm really impressed, Hector. Honestly, I thought you were going to get distracted by Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's great to know we can count on you.

nodes.text: Don't get me wrong. I'm really excited to be back with Amanda, but there is a time and a place for `PDA.`

nodes.text: A week ago, on the night of the fire at Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: This is what you asked for, right? You wanted the fireworks from Hector's van?

nodes.text: Heh... Perfect.

nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.text: I told you Steph could get the job done, Tom.

nodes.text: Okay then. See you around.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hold up, Steph.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't you want to know what I'm going to do with these fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Why should I? I'm helping you because you promised to get me an internship at Prince Research Labs.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: As long as you hold up your end of the bargain, you can do whatever you like to Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you sure? You're telling me you have no doubts? No anxiety? No lingering pangs of remorse over double-crossing your own high school?
